trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Work the roadmap in order, save 100% Completion for last, and this lands with it. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the game — no detour needed. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order as you play the main missions; keep following the story and this pops at the chapter's end. Source: official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: play the story missions in order and it unlocks at the end of Chapter 2. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Play the story missions in order; it unlocks at the end of Chapter 3. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Play the story missions in order; it unlocks at the end of Chapter 4. Source: official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story finale — play the main missions through to the end and the gold pops with the credits. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission; play it when it appears in the mission list and the trophy pops on completion. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission set around the airport; complete it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The game's completion checklist covers the story, activities, collectibles and side content — finish everything else in this guide and this gold pops last, just before the platinum. Track your percentage in the game's stats and mop up whatever category is short. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and trick driving — the game counts them as you go, and PSN tracks the total to 250. Drive fast, take jumps and ramps, and let the counter climb; it is a grind, not a skill test, so fold it into free roam between missions. Source: official description; count target per PSNProfiles.
trophies.source: Official description · count target per PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in Leonida — races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK spots. Sample one of each; you do not need to win or finish, just try it. Source: official description; 9 types per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 range challenges and each needs a gold score. Learn each range's scoring — accuracy and speed beat spray-and-pray — and retry freely, since ranges can be replayed as often as you like. Source: official description; 42 challenges per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone-race locations; win one race at each. Learn the gates on each course — a clean line beats raw speed — and races can be retried. Source: official description; 14 locations per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, boat or air, whichever the game offers. You need 20 different events, so spread your wins around instead of repeating one. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge against Cal and outscore him. Fishing is a timing mini-game — hook, reel steadily, and do not let the line snap. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida and finish one full game — any cabinet, any game. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand runs through the game; finish his last mission and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand ends with his final mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends with his final mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; finish 8 full strands, each a short chain. Keep an eye on the map between story missions and clear them as they appear. Source: official description; 8 strands per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand ends with his final mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with his final mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; sit and meditate at each one. Spots are scattered across the state — visit them while exploring and the counter climbs. Source: official description; 18 spots per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one unique animal — track it in the wilds of Leonida and take it down. Bring a scoped weapon and approach quietly. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Collect as you explore — three full sets is the target, so keep picking cards up whenever you see one. Source: official description; 3 sets per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across Leonida; use one at 100 different locations. Fold this into exploration — hit a WAiNK spot whenever you pass one and the counter climbs. Source: official description; 100 locations per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; finish any 50. They stack up naturally across activities and free roam — check the challenges list and chase the easy ones first. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you when the stars drop — set it up deliberately, do not leave it to chance.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you, a 4-star wanted level, and a clean escape. Set it up deliberately: build heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: The run fails if the wanted level clears between shops — attempt it deliberately, not mid-mission.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time — no cooling off between robberies. Plan a route through three nearby shops, keep the car ready, and do not let the stars drop. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Any 100 distinct vehicles count — drive, steal or just approach them and the game logs each new one. Vary what you drive and the counter climbs; check the vehicle list to see what is missing. Source: official description; 100 vehicles per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and drop five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, wait for enemies to cluster, then activate it. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: A one-moment stunt at the airport — do it when the story takes you to VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in an aircraft without a scheduled flight — steal a plane from the tarmac and take off. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the military tanks that roll in at high wanted levels. The official description does not pin down the exact trigger — the safe read is to engage a Rhino, destroying one or surviving its attention, at a high wanted level. Try it during a 4–5 star rampage and watch for the pop. Source: official description; trigger not pinned down in the official text.
trophies.source: Official description · trigger not pinned down in the official text

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_note: The 'without being detected' condition is the whole trophy — a loud robbery does not count, so attempt it stealth-first.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean. Plan the approach, use stealth, and if you are spotted the run fails the condition, so retry. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults are the big heists of the robbery loop — plan each one, escape, and repeat until the counter hits five. Source: official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cash, and lose the heat. Trucks run set routes — find one, hit it fast, and escape before the response arrives. Source: official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas to visit — every named district and region on the map. Drive, fly or sail through each one and the counter climbs; check the map for the areas you have not set foot in. Source: official description; 52 areas per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs running illegal operations; hit one operation per gang. Each gang's turf is marked by its operations — work through all nine. Source: official description; 9 gangs per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or venue on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and enjoy it. This is a flavour moment — no combat, just the view. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a vehicle showroom and out the other side, GTA-style. The official description does not pin down which showroom — any vehicle showroom you can drive through should count; try it in free roam. Source: official description; showroom not pinned down in the official text.
trophies.source: Official description · showroom not pinned down in the official text

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Leonida. Just complete a game — no strike needed. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: The trigger is not pinned down in the official text — treat it as a story/partner beat, not a grind.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no repeatable target — this reads as a specific partner moment, not a grind. Treat it as a story/partner beat and keep playing the partner content; do not chase a number for this one. Source: official description; trigger not pinned down in the official text.
trophies.source: Official description · trigger not pinned down in the official text

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — make choices, dialogue and decision moments, until the counter hits 500. It stacks across the whole playthrough, so it lands late; keep choosing and check the counter in the stats. Source: official description; count target per PSNProfiles.
trophies.source: Official description · count target per PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: The trigger is not pinned down in the official text — do not grind for it; it should pop when the moment comes.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The official description gives no repeatable target — this reads as a specific second-attempt event. Do not grind for it; it should pop when the moment comes in normal play. Source: official description; trigger not pinned down in the official text.
trophies.source: Official description · trigger not pinned down in the official text

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: The trigger is not pinned down in the official text — likely a rare event; explore the odd corners of Leonida.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The official description gives no repeatable target — this reads as a rare or random event, in GTA's tradition of strange encounters. Explore the odd corners of Leonida and it should surface. Source: official description; trigger not pinned down in the official text.
trophies.source: Official description · trigger not pinned down in the official text

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a target on foot, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total counts to $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score and the counter climbs. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, gear — any spending across shops counts, and the total is $100,000. It stacks across the whole playthrough; spend normally and top up with big purchases late. Source: official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida. Save up and buy them all — each one also gives you storage for your collection. Source: official description; 8 garages per PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 vehicles you own or find. Any 10 count — register as you discover new rides. Source: official description.
